verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is API-first. Its docs say documents, embeddings, full-text, semantic and conversational search are all exposed 'from a single API', with dedicated endpoints such as facet search, API-key-authenticated requests, and official typed SDKs in ten languages. The docs are also served as LLM-friendly markdown plus llms.txt, and community users report standing it up and integrating it easily, though one user said index and settings setup took substantial coding. Missing for 10: no API reference page in the evidence pack, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
